description: **Core mechanic** : Korvold turns every permanent you sacrifice into a +1/+1 counter AND a card — the classic Jund sac engine (Mayhem Devil pings, Viscera Seer/Ashnod's Altar fuel the loop).
**Engine** : sacrifice outlets + token/fetch fodder + draw-on-sac triggers (Korvold himself, Grim Haruspex-type effects).
**Payoff** : a giant flying Korvold that draws into more sac fodder every turn.
win: **Draw into value** : every sacrifice replaces itself — keep the engine fed and never run out of gas.
**Commander damage** : a 10/10+ flying Korvold closes in 2 hits.
**Mayhem Devil drain** : each sacrifice pings the table for 1-2, finishing low life totals.

combos.description:

When the creature dies, Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.

Repeat.

Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

description: **Core mechanic** : Treasure tokens are the perfect sacrifice fodder — they make mana AND trigger Korvold's draw/+1/+1 (Pitiless Plunderer, Goldspan Dragon, Xorn double them).
**Engine** : treasure generators + artifact-sac outlets + token doublers.
**Payoff** : massive mana for X-spells and big plays while Korvold grows every time you crack a treasure.
win: **Mana explosion** : crack 10+ treasures a turn for game-winning X-spells or board-wide plays.
**Draw engine** : each treasure sacrificed draws a card off Korvold — velocity.
**Combo fuel** : treasures feed the Plunderer/Altar loops that end the game.

description: **Core mechanic** : the classic aristocrats engine — recursive creatures (Gravecrawler, Reassembling Skeleton, Squee) + sac outlets + drain payoffs (Zulaport Cutthroat, Blood Artist, Mayhem Devil).
**Engine** : infinite or near-infinite sac loops with free or cheap sac outlets.
**Payoff** : table-wide drain that closes games without combat.
win: **Drain loops** : every recursion cycle pings the table — 20+ life gone in a turn.
**Korvold growth** : each loop cycle also pumps Korvold into a flying finisher.
**Combo wins** : Gravecrawler + Pitiless Plunderer + outlet = infinite mana + drain.

win: **Draw velocity** : each land sac replaces itself — keep the engine fed and out-draw everyone.
**Infinite loops** : Aftermath Analyst + sac outlet + fetchland = infinite landfall triggers and Korvold draws.
**Commander damage** : a 10/10+ flying Korvold closes in 2 hits after the land engine churns.

quick_read: **Sacrifice value engine** : every permanent you sacrifice draws a card and grows Korvold — the whole deck loops sac outlets, fodder and payoffs.
**Two dominant plans** : Sacrifice (1,626 decks) and Treasure (1,589) — the treasure generators ARE the best sac fodder, so the plans merge naturally.
**Combo-ready** : Pitiless Plunderer + Ashnod's Altar + any recursive creature = infinite mana, and Korvold's draw finds the pieces.
primer.source_html: "two of the most powerful payoffs for one of the strongest strategies in Commander… Aristocrats decks are a core part of Commander's identity, and they can count on absurdly strong cards like Korvold to lead their engines." — "The Five Best Titan Triggers in Commander" (EDHREC Articles, 2026)
primer.combos_note: 8 combos from Commander Spellbook (2 involving Korvold 👑), filtered to Jund identity + ≥2/3 overlap with the recommended pool + popularity ≥ 100.

**Token value** : Food and treasure synergies — a topdeck engine for the sac plan.
**The engine himself** : every sacrifice draws a card and pumps him — the whole deck revolves around this trigger.
**Endless sac target** : returns from graveyard for 2 mana — infinite loop fodder with any outlet.
**Treasure wincon** : 10 treasures at your upkeep = win the game — a real alternative closing line.
**Sac payoff** : sacrifices artifacts/creatures for mana and reanimates — value recursion.
**Saga payoff** : makes a 4/4 Dragon and treasures — a one-card value engine that feeds the sac plan.
**Drain payoff** : every time one of your creatures dies, each opponent loses 1 — the aristocrats damage dealer.
Flex: **Free recursion** : returns from graveyard at instant speed — endless sac fodder in the loops.

**Creature tutor** : sacrifice a creature to tutor any creature with mana value +2 — finds the engine or finisher.

**Free mana** : sacrifice a creature for {B}{B}{B} — turns a dork into a burst that feeds the sac plan's big plays.
